sessions.phase_label: SEO planning, negotiation, and trial-scope confirmation
Keyword research and on-page SEO planning
Blog production, review, and website publication
On-page completion and backlink indexing review

requirements.title: SEO Keyword Target Set
requirements.definition: Select and maintain the agreed set of target SEO keywords, including client-requested substitutions and keywords assigned to blog content.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the selected terms and target-keyword count. Search-volume data is separate because it can be missing or corrected while the selected keyword set remains unchanged.

requirements.title: Keyword Search-Volume Data
requirements.definition: Include search-volume data for the keywords in the delivered keyword research sheet.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate from keyword selection because the search-volume column was independently requested, omitted, and revised without changing the underlying target terms.

requirements.title: SEO Blog Article Delivery
requirements.definition: Produce and publish the agreed number of SEO blog articles on the client's website.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers article quantity and delivery to the website. Project delivery dates and daily scheduling are excluded, while independently assessable content and approval constraints are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Blog Approval Before Publication
requirements.definition: Submit blog content for client review and obtain approval before publishing it on the website.
requirements.boundary_note: Represents the independently enforceable publication gate, not routine communication or scheduling around content delivery.

requirements.title: Blog Topic, Keyword, and Audience Targeting
requirements.definition: Align each blog's topic, use of approved keywords, and intended audience with the client's content direction.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers article-level subject and audience semantics, including the Gen Z direction for the AI-dolls article. Keyword-list research remains a sibling Requirement, and images, links, and length are separate acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Relevant Images in Blog Articles
requirements.definition: Include and retain relevant images in each commissioned blog article, using the client-specified image count where stated.
requirements.boundary_note: Images are independently testable and modifiable relative to article links, word count, topic, and publication status.

requirements.title: Internal Links in Blog Articles
requirements.definition: Add relevant internal links from blog articles to the client's products and related website content.
requirements.boundary_note: Internal linking has its own observable acceptance criterion and can be changed or omitted independently of images and article length.

requirements.title: Blog Article Word Count
requirements.definition: Make each applicable blog article exceed approximately 1,500 words where practicable.
requirements.boundary_note: Article length is a distinct content acceptance criterion rather than an attribute of image placement, internal linking, or publication workflow.

requirements.title: Guest Post Delivery
requirements.definition: Include guest-post work in the SEO engagement, with the client able to select guest-post opportunities where applicable.
requirements.boundary_note: Guest posting is distinct from ordinary backlink creation and remains a historical Requirement even though later trial-scope negotiation excluded it.

requirements.title: Meta Title and Description Optimization
requirements.definition: Optimize website meta titles and meta descriptions as part of the agreed on-page SEO work.
requirements.boundary_note: Meta titles and descriptions form one paired metadata mechanism. Heading hierarchy, image ALT text, and documentation of changes are not merged into this Requirement.

requirements.title: Heading Structure Optimization
requirements.definition: Correct the website's H1 usage and heading hierarchy according to the approved on-page SEO suggestions.
requirements.boundary_note: Heading structure can be implemented and checked independently of metadata, image ALT attributes, and sitemap behavior.

requirements.title: Image ALT Text Optimization
requirements.definition: Add or update appropriate ALT attributes for website images as part of on-page SEO optimization.
requirements.boundary_note: ALT-text coverage is independently testable and has a separate implementation trajectory from blog images, headings, and metadata.

requirements.title: Search-Engine Sitemap Configuration
requirements.definition: Maintain an error-free, accessible sitemap and submit it successfully for processing by Google Search Console.
requirements.boundary_note: Sitemap correction, accessibility, and Search Console submission are tightly coupled parts of one indexing mechanism, distinct from backlink indexing.

requirements.title: Webpage Keyword Content Update
requirements.definition: Update applicable webpage content to use the client-approved target terms while preserving areas identified as reserved.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers implementation of approved terms in webpage content. It is separate from selecting the keyword list and from the independently handled Back to School landing-page edits.

requirements.title: Back to School Landing-Page Optimization
requirements.definition: Apply the agreed pending SEO and content edits to the Back to School sale landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: The page-specific task has its own access path, pending-suggestion artifact, and implementation claim. Exact edit details are unavailable because they were supplied in attachments.

requirements.title: Backlink Campaign Delivery
requirements.definition: Create the agreed backlink campaign with the specified link quantity and a mixed dofollow/nofollow profile.
requirements.boundary_note: Backlink quantity, source diversity, and follow-type ratio are attributes of one campaign mechanism. Search-engine indexing of delivered links has a separate failure and remediation trajectory.

requirements.title: Backlink Indexing
requirements.definition: Submit campaign backlinks for Google indexing and re-submit links that remain unindexed when requested.
requirements.boundary_note: Indexing is separate from backlink creation because links can exist while remaining absent from Google or third-party index reports. A replacement guarantee for persistently unindexed links is not included without a confirmed policy.

unresolved_candidates.description: The approved on-page suggestions were supplied in an attachment. Additional independently evolving on-page Requirements may be present but cannot be recovered safely from the visible message text.
The client asks whether backlinks that remain unindexed after several weeks will be replaced, but the visible history does not establish an accepted replacement policy.
The Back to School landing-page task is independently identifiable, but the exact required edits are contained in an unavailable pending-suggestions attachment.
